zh-CN.title: 个性化收藏更好找
items: 背景、气泡与头像框支持按解锁等级或品质分组
新增全部、已拥有、未拥有筛选，快速定位可用装扮
装扮名称直接使用品质色，不再重复标注品质名称
奖励品质集中展示在预览左上角，奖励信息更易识别
下一等级的背景与气泡改用个性化列表同款预览

en.title: A better organized personalization library
items: Group backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames by unlock level or rarity
Filter the library by all, owned, or not owned items
Item names now carry their rarity color without redundant rarity labels
Reward rarity now sits at the top-left of each preview for faster recognition
Next-level backgrounds and bubbles now use the same previews as Personalization
